title: Ingress Bounty Bonus Progress
summary: Check whether your Ingress bounty bonus tokens are on pace to reach the campaign medal tiers.
description:
Enter your current bounty bonus token count and see your progress toward each medal tier of the active campaign — **Bronze**, **Silver**, and **Gold** — alongside the days remaining and the daily-login bonus tokens still available before it ends.

- **Gap coverage** — for each tier, how many days of daily bonuses would cover the remaining gap.
- **Early warning** — flags when the daily bonus alone can no longer get you there, so you know when extra activity is needed.

Campaign dates, tiers, and rates live in a small data file, so the page is reused for each new campaign.
